mapper.select: SELECT process_code, workstation_name AS name, SUM(quantity_qualified) AS value FROM pro_feedback WHERE MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE()) AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY process_code, name ORDER BY process_code
select count(*) as count from pro_feedback where workorder_code = #{workorderCode} and task_code = #{taskCode} and quantity_qualified > 0 and status = 'WAREHOUSED' and deleted = 0
select quantity as quantity from iot_device_feedback_log where enable_status = 'CONFIRMED' and device_code = #{machineryCode} ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC limit 1

WITH TodayFeedback AS ( SELECT id, feedback_code, origin_code, team_code, principal_name, tenant_id, feedback_time, workstation_code, workstation_name, workorder_code, workorder_name, process_code, process_name, task_code, item_code, item_name, specification, unit_of_measure, quantity, quantity_feedback, quantity_qualified, quantity_unquanlified, user_name, nick_name, feedback_channel, record_user, record_nick, status, remark, report_fee, pay_fee, batch_code, erp_batch_code, defect_id, shift_info, machinery_name, machinery_code, machinery_id, erp_feedback, task_status, erp_feedback_status, erp_warehousing_status, merge_status, conversion_quantity, conversion_unit, conversion_quantity_unquanlified , quantity_excess FROM pro_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 and quantity_qualified > 0 and merge_flag is null and status in ('FINISHED' , 'WAREHOUSED')
AND workorder_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.workorderCode}, '%')
AND feedback_time BETWEEN #{params.beginTime} AND #{params.endTime}
AND process_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.processName}, '%')
AND nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.nikeName}, '%')
AND process_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.processCode}, '%')
AND unit_of_measure LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.unitOfMeasure}, '%')
), BaseMembers AS ( SELECT f.id, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT(m.nick_name, '(', IFNULL(CAST(m.quantity AS DECIMAL(20,2)), '0.00'), ')') ORDER BY m.nick_name SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS participants, SUM(m.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM TodayFeedback f JOIN pro_feedback_member m ON CONVERT(f.id, CHAR) = m.feedback_id WHERE m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY f.id ), OriginMembers AS ( SELECT f.id, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT(om.nick_name, '(', IFNULL(CAST(om.quantity AS DECIMAL(20,2)), '0.00'), ')') ORDER BY om.nick_name SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS origin_participants, SUM(om.quantity) AS origin_total_quantity FROM TodayFeedback f JOIN ( SELECT id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(origin_code, ',', n.n), ',', -1) AS origin_feedback_code FROM TodayFeedback CROSS JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 ) n WHERE origin_code IS NOT NULL AND n.n <= LENGTH(origin_code) - LENGTH(REPLACE(origin_code, ',', '')) + 1 ) split ON f.id = split.id JOIN pro_feedback_member om ON split.origin_feedback_code = om.feedback_id WHERE om.deleted = 0 GROUP BY f.id ), UserProduction AS ( SELECT f.id, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN m.nick_name = #{params.participantKeyword} THEN m.quantity ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS user_quantity FROM TodayFeedback f LEFT JOIN pro_feedback_member m ON CONVERT(f.id, CHAR) = m.feedback_id AND m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY f.id ), CombinedData AS ( SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN f.origin_code IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(bm.participants, ''), COALESCE(om.origin_participants, '') ) ELSE COALESCE(bm.participants, '') END AS all_participants, COALESCE(bm.total_quantity, 0) AS base_total_quantity, COALESCE(om.origin_total_quantity, 0) AS origin_total_quantity, CONCAT( CASE WHEN f.quantity_feedback > 0 THEN ROUND((f.quantity_qualified / f.quantity_feedback) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END, '%' ) AS passrate, COALESCE(up.user_quantity, 0) AS user_production_quantity FROM TodayFeedback f LEFT JOIN BaseMembers bm ON f.id = bm.id LEFT JOIN OriginMembers om ON f.id = om.id LEFT JOIN UserProduction up ON f.id = up.id ) SELECT * FROM CombinedData WHERE 1 = 1
AND user_production_quantity > 0 AND all_participants LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.participantKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY feedback_time DESC
